Kmerseek Case Gallery

Two views. 183 short-feature cases: the cases from notebook 244 (PR #49) (report half; features under 60 aa placed by kmerseek at 50–90% identity), one at a time, drawn from the exported call coordinates. Arrow keys page, S stars. Star the ones for Figure 2; the list at the bottom stays in this browser and copies as text. Every case also shows every k-mer the human and target protein share. Three reference pairs: Ced9 → BCL2, P66 → CD47 and BHF → human, from notebook 241 (PR #46), with every alphabet and k, each tool's calls, and every shared k-mer.

the Swiss-Prot feature being scored (human) or transferred from (target) kmerseek: call lands on the feature (≥ 80% of the call inside, ≥ 30% of the feature covered) call mostly inside the feature, lower IoU than kmerseek call overlaps the feature but less than half of the call is inside it (spills) call reaches kmerseek's IoU or higher ×no call of this feature type overlaps the feature ○the tool's best call is on another target protein (drawn on the human side only) Hin the residue rows: hydrophobic class (hp_pbotc_1st_ed2, H = ACFILMPVWY)

Sources for the 183 cases: tables/244_hero_candidates.csv, tables/244_case_calls.csv and tables/244_case_sequences.fasta on branch olgabot/244-all-case-figures (PR #78), exported 29 Sep 2026 by scripts/export_244_case_calls.py with the notebook's own functions; the four notebook-printed coordinate pairs reproduce. Bars are the tools' calls at their exported coordinates; the target panel shows a tool's call only when its best call is on the same target protein as kmerseek's. The residue rows are the kmerseek chosen arm's matched region on both proteins, gapless, position against position. IoU is the overlap between a call and the feature divided by their union. pLDDT is the mean AlphaFold confidence over the feature. Other Swiss-Prot features on the proteins are not in the export, so only the scored feature is drawn.

Shared k-mer views: kmerseek pair from kmerseek 0.3.1 (commit 921baa7), the build the 183 cases were run with. The 183 JSONs are figures/244_pairs/ (scripts/pair_244_cases.py); 137 of the run's calls are one of pair's runs exactly, and in the other 46 a longer pair run on the same diagonal contains the call. Reference pairs: the 152 alphabet and k values of notebook 241 (PR #46); its plan.json, ranks.csv, arms.csv and queries.fa are copied to the branch. Its 260 MB regions.parquet is not on GitHub; the top-20 hit lists taken from it are tables/case_gallery/hits241.json. Other tools: scripts/case_gallery/run_other_tools.sh, raw hits in tables/case_gallery/other_tools/. Every page table is built by scripts/case_gallery/ into tables/case_gallery/, and assemble.py writes this page to reports/case_gallery/case_gallery.html on branch olgabot/case-gallery-reference-pairs (PR #80). Every one of the 250 Ced9 and P66 search regions on BCL2 or CD47 lies on the diagonal of a pair run. BH1 coordinates: UniProt P41958 and P10415, whose sequences match the ones used here. Human sequences: GENCODE v49 canonical translations. Coordinates are 1-based on the page.
